name: John L. Sullivan
bio: The heavyweight boxing champion appears in the Cow Boy's sporting news, which in 1885 said his backers were losing confidence in him and doubted his planned fight with Paddy Ryan at Butte City, Montana, would take place. In November 1886 the paper reported that he knocked out Ryan in the third round in San Francisco.
